adversarial_vectors.expect: OBSERVATION_BINDING_MISMATCH

adversarial_vectors.input: normalized profile with non-null raw_response_sha256 or tool-reported content copied into headers

adversarial_vectors.input: redirect_chain >2, cross-origin URL, URL query/fragment, or wire_bytes>1048576
adversarial_vectors.expect: OBSERVATION_PROFILE_INSUFFICIENT/RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE; no metadata

adversarial_vectors.input: duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Infinity, depth 33, invalid UTF-8, >1 MiB
adversarial_vectors.expect: stable ARTIFACT_INVALID/OBSERVATION_MISSING/limit refusal before writes; no traceback

adversarial_vectors.input: complete synthetic named sections with consecutive L<number>: prefixes on one physical line
adversarial_vectors.expect: accept; title/authors/abstract/subjects/cite/history extracted only from named sections

adversarial_vectors.input: CAP-WEB-OBS-001 incomplete 5804-byte excerpt
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARXIV_METADATA_INCOMPLETE; never infer abstract/dates from footer links

adversarial_vectors.input: missing Abstract, duplicate conflicting Title, duplicate conflicting Cite-as, truncated section
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARXIV_METADATA_INCOMPLETE or ARXIV_VERSION_MISMATCH; no partial metadata

adversarial_vectors.input: page ID/cite marker belongs to another paper
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARXIV_ID_MISMATCH

adversarial_vectors.input: explicit request v2 but page proves v1; explicit not_found
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARXIV_VERSION_MISMATCH / ARXIV_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE, respectively; no fallback request

adversarial_vectors.input: unversioned page with current version but incomplete submission history
adversarial_vectors.expect: metadata succeeds with resolved_version and latest_at_observation=null; other_versions_exist=unknown

adversarial_vectors.input: complete history where resolved version=max(history)
adversarial_vectors.expect: latest_at_observation=true; history proving another version exists is retained

adversarial_vectors.input: only one observed version string with no explicit latest marker/history
adversarial_vectors.expect: never infer v1/latest; use null/unknown

adversarial_vectors.input: caller changes abstract/date/resolved_version while resealing envelope
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARTIFACT_BINDING_MISMATCH or ARXIV_* refusal; metadata must derive from observation

adversarial_vectors.input: matching graph age 24h-1s
adversarial_vectors.expect: exact reference reuse, same timestamps/capability, no new observation

adversarial_vectors.input: matching graph age 24h+1s or --refresh
adversarial_vectors.expect: fetch required; no Python network call; no mutation except valid staged request if contract permits

adversarial_vectors.input: corrupt matching graph / same request with explicit-vs-unversioned policy
adversarial_vectors.expect: refusal, never cache miss; policy-separated keys

adversarial_vectors.input: prompt template or metadata bytes tampered; unknown model/runtime with empty reason
adversarial_vectors.expect: prompt hash/binding refusal; unknown identity shape refusal

adversarial_vectors.input: section missing/extra, empty text, >4000 chars, wrong classification, non-abstract extracted fact
adversarial_vectors.expect: PREVIEW_PROPOSAL_INVALID or scope refusal

adversarial_vectors.input: hostile title/section/source strings with Markdown delimiters/newlines
adversarial_vectors.expect: escaped deterministic Markdown; no link/frontmatter injection

adversarial_vectors.input: session path outside .work/research, traversal, symlink ancestor, FIFO/special file, hardlink
adversarial_vectors.expect: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE/ARTIFACT_INVALID before writes

adversarial_vectors.input: unexpected file/dir in five family dirs, >256 files, >256 decisions, missing named ancestor appears mid-operation
adversarial_vectors.expect: SESSION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or WORK_PATH_UNSAFE; complete graph not reported current

adversarial_vectors.input: same digest path different bytes or same decision event_id changed payload
adversarial_vectors.expect: conflict; preserve old bytes; DECISION_CONFLICT exit 75 for event reuse

adversarial_vectors.input: persistent replacement of session/family/reference directory during success and exception paths
adversarial_vectors.expect: WORK_PATH_UNSAFE dominates child/parser error; no false success

adversarial_vectors.input: wrong session/kind/hash/ref ID, gap/divergent previous, missing metadata/observation
adversarial_vectors.expect: ARTIFACT_BINDING_MISMATCH or DECISION_INVALID; list/cache validates full graph

adversarial_vectors.input: skip/later with selected_version; ingest without --selected-version; selected version != resolved
adversarial_vectors.expect: DECISION_INVALID; no decision file

adversarial_vectors.input: same event exact replay; same event changed preview/action/text; same sequence divergent predecessor/competing writer
adversarial_vectors.expect: exact reuse; DECISION_CONFLICT exit 75; chain remains contiguous

adversarial_vectors.input: fixture source vs user_message source; unversioned latest_unknown ingest
adversarial_vectors.expect: fixture visibly labeled; ingest requires explicit resolved version and shows latest_unknown

adversarial_vectors.input: missing option, unknown subcommand, malformed JSON path, internal error
adversarial_vectors.expect: JSON envelope, exit 2/refusal, no traceback or unlimited echo

adversarial_vectors.input: monkeypatch socket/subprocess, admin sentinel PATH, snapshot Vault/catalog/seed/other commands
adversarial_vectors.expect: no network/admin/subprocess; bytes unchanged; only .work/research/session writes

adversarial_vectors.input: isolated install/import
adversarial_vectors.expect: research CLI, 7 schemas + prompt byte-exact; existing common.v1 and commands byte-exact

unresolved_review_points: Candidate review must confirm normalized parser accepts the frozen consecutive-prefix stream without accidentally consuming section labels or footer links.
Candidate must prove metadata is derived from trusted named sections and not from generic URL/footer scanning.
Storage tests must inject directory replacement on both success and exception paths and prove WORK_PATH_UNSAFE takes precedence.
The six freeze conditions (CAP exact bytes, one CLI registration call, 1 MiB limit, exit 75 conflicts, seven wheel resources, concise Skill) need exact candidate evidence.
